workingTree: Contains the previously reviewed uncommitted changes; architecture pass changes documentation/metrics only.

method.frontend: Maintained frontend production TS/TSX; relative imports resolved, external packages/CSS/JSON excluded from source-module cycle detection. Type-only and dynamic imports classified separately. Function branches are a syntactic estimate, excluding nested functions; not a canonical complexity score.
method.backend: Maintained backend/app Python source; local AST imports resolve modules and from-imported submodules. Imports inside functions are deferred, TYPE_CHECKING imports are type-only. Syntactic branch estimate excludes nested function bodies. Framework/module registration can intentionally use deferred imports.
method.lines: Physical lines, including blanks/comments; measured with splitlines (TS parser positions for function ranges).
method.fanInOut: Distinct maintained production source modules joined by static value imports/re-exports; excludes type-only imports, dynamic imports, JSON/CSS and external packages. A zero static fan-in can mean a lazy-loaded game.
method.branches: Syntactic branch estimates include boolean/conditional/loop/case/catch branches, excluding nested function bodies. Outer hook/component lines include nested callbacks but their branch estimates do not, so these are not canonical complexity scores.
method.openapi: Generated locally with an in-memory-configured application factory; no lifecycle/server/database writes. Empty schemas are counted separately from successful responses with no JSON body.
method.cycleLimit: Local syntactic module-import graph, not a whole-program call graph. Python package self-imports are ignored. Implicit package initialization, reflective imports, framework wiring, third-party dependencies and stylesheet dependencies are outside cycle detection.
